# Aaroh Kandhare

Canonical URL: https://aarohkandy.github.io/

Location: Bellevue, Washington

## Summary

Aaroh Kandhare builds rockets, combat robots, AI hardware and a Linux you install with a double click.

## Projects

- auros: A Linux you install with a double click, set up for one person or one kiosk, where ten lines of YAML go in and a bootable machine comes out. (building it now)
- moonshot: I lead engineering on Moonshot's 51-part AI wearable, which is shipping now, and before it went to the factory I caught the camera sitting 2.25 mm outside its own housing. (Y Combinator-backed · engineering team lead · 11 factory drawings · 168 fit checks across 1,275 part pairs)
- rocket: I built a 3D-printed rocket that steers with its own thrust, and wrote the 6-DOF simulator that's put it through 14,030 runs. (sponsored by Stanford · thrust vector control · 430 g · flight computer in electronics testing)
- cadybara: I'm the first engineer at Cadybara, a Founders Inc-backed text-to-CAD startup, and I built the backend and the public arena where AI-generated designs go head to head. (my study there: more prompt detail made the CAD worse, 62.5% at level 7 against 40.1% at level 10)
- research: I design air, surface and underwater vehicles and the ocean-atmosphere missions they run for NOAA's lab at the University of Washington, and I speed up metal 3D-printing models at Northwestern. (UW and NOAA PMEL · Northwestern · 14.7 TB of model output indexed without downloading it)
- battlebots: I've built and fought combat robots at 1, 3, 5 and 25 lb, and now I lead design on a 250 lb one for a planned 2028 BattleBots entry. (founder, Mantis · design lead, Bravado · a brushless hub motor I designed for the 1 lb)
- vex: I placed 2nd in a VEX World Championship division, and I've qualified for Worlds five times in eight seasons since fourth grade. (captain and engineering lead · VEX IQ and V5)
- frc: On FRC 1899 I led 17 students across 3 subteams on a t-shirt cannon, and built mechanisms for our 2024 World Championship robot. (Saints Robotics · offseason project lead · mechanical)
- vaidra: I built Vaidra's speech pipeline in 7 languages, for classrooms in India that have one speaker and no screens. (COO, 2025 to 2026 · reached about 9,000 students)
- mosscross: Moss wrecks roofs here and the companies scraping it off by hand make too much money to automate it, so we're doing it with drones and an autopilot I wrote. (backed by Founders Inc · the autopilot plans coverage across a roof and corrects for wind)
- coacht: I co-founded CoachT, AI coaching software for taekwondo studios, and it was acquired when I was 16. (chief marketing officer · 50+ studio accounts · automated all of our outreach)
